en.hubeali:
Ahmad, from Ali, from Sayf, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
When asked, Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> said:
‘The keeping (of the intention) in the mind is more beloved to measws, therefore exclaim Talbiyya and do not specify’.
en.sarwar: 9. Ahmad has narrated from Ali ibn Sayf from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, naming and
he (the Imam) said, ‘Not to mention is more likeable to me. Say Talbiyah and do not mention.’”
